To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the coupling of a 3D fluid solver with a 0D model can be performed in two ways: (i) by solving the 0D equations in the first fractional step and then solving the 3D equations in the second fractional step (explicit coupling); or (ii) by solving the coupled system in the first fractional-step (implicit coupling).

(i) explicit 3D- 0D coupling methods might lead to severe numerical instabilities in the presence of multiple outlets and (ii) an implicit approach is more robust and requires negligible additional computational cost compared to the explicit one.
